column2: [intro]
When I was young, at school it began
Facing the class, my heart would pound
Trembling legs, sweaty hands, all I ran
Stage fright engulfed me, couldn't think or sound
I've always had a lot of stage fright
It makes me panic, makes me blurred, makes me tight
Stage fright follows me, it's my constant friend
But I'll face it, make it my song in the end
Later on stage, it was even worse
Eyes fixed on me, I lost my verse
But I decided not to let stage fright immerse
I'll transform it, make it my show, my rehearse
I've always had a lot of stage fright
It makes me panic, makes me blurred, makes me tight
Stage fright follows me, it's my constant friend
But I'll face it, make it my song in the end
[ solo ]
Yes, stage fright is here, but I'll move on
On stage, I'll give my all, have my fun
The audience will laugh, sing along with me
Because this song, my stage fright, sets me free
[outro]
